sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops when any link in the chain is nil — the entire expression collapses to nothing
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through a chain of connections, but if any single link is absent, the whole attempt quietly fails to reach them.

sketches.mechanism: The 'object' keyword creates a singleton — exactly one instance can ever exist, enforced by the language
sketches.resonance: Declaring something as truly one-of-a-kind is not sentiment but a structural guarantee no runtime can violate.

sketches.mechanism: A goroutine sending on a channel with no receiver blocks forever — the program deadlocks and the runtime kills it
sketches.resonance: A voice that speaks into a channel no one is listening to doesn't just go unheard — it freezes everything.
